title: Galactic Civilizations III: Crusade Expansion Pack
summary: Expansion for Galactic Civilizations III that deepens the 4X layer with citizens, governance, espionage, expanded civilization creation and other strategic systems; it is not a standalone game.

observations.statement: Crusade adds several management and customization systems that materially broaden the base game's strategic decision space.
A reviewed user noted expansion-ownership friction in multiplayer when participants do not share the same DLC set.

steam_reviews.query: Steam Community review pages; Russian and non-Russian lanes attempted; accessible index was sparse
